thread:
amanda: deploy-bot flagged release v2026.03 for pause — env parity check failed
deploy-bot: preflight check failed: SSM key name format mismatch between staging and prod. See below. Release paused. :warning:
ci-bot: preflight log snippet:
```
preflight: comparing secret metadata
staging.ssm_key = /redwood/inference/credentials/redis
prod.ssm_key = redwood/inference/credentials/redis
result: mismatch -> pause
```
raj: ugh, leading slash. this will break ssm path resolution in our deploy shim (we strip leading slash in prod codepath?)
leo: confirming — runtime code expects key without leading slash, but the SSM importer we used last month wrote keys with a leading slash into staging only.
maria: who owns the SSM import job? cc @sre-ops
sre-ops: that was the onboarding script run by infra-team on staging last week. we backfilled keys and our script kept leading slashes. we didn't realize deploycheck normalizes differently for prod.
amanda: two questions: 1) can we hotfix the staging keys to remove leading slash? 2) or do we patch the deploy shim to accept both formats? which is lower risk for this release window?
leo: hotfixing staging keys is quick but we need a small migration and audit. command is basically `aws ssm get-parameter --name '/redwood/...'` and `put-parameter --name 'redwood/...' --value ...`. risk: if we accidentally create duplicate paramnames we could confuse other jobs.
raj: patching the shim adds code churn right before release. I'd prefer migration + backfill and then re-run preflight.
deploy-bot: release v2026.03 (canary -> prod) currently paused by policy: env-parity-secret-path. Rollout window at 2026-03-21 23:00 UTC.
maria: agree with raj. action: @leo to run backfill script, @sre-ops to audit and monitor. we should pin the service image for this rollout (no additional changes).
sre-ops: will create audit log entry and a short rollback plan. if anything 5xx in canary within 10m -> rollback.
leo: starting backfill now. command I'm running: `for p in $(aws ssm describe-parameters --query 'Parameters[?starts_with(Name,`/redwood`)].Name' --output text); do v=$(aws ssm get-parameter --name "$p" --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text); new=$(echo "$p" | sed 's|^/||'); aws ssm put-parameter --name "$new" --value "$v" --type SecureString --overwrite; done`
amanda: very careful w/ overwrite. please dry-run first and share list of params you will touch.
leo: doing dry-run -> found 6 staging params with leading slash. sending list in DM and to the release thread in 5m.
ci-bot: preflight re-run scheduled after manual ack from amanda. use `/release unpause 1754443333` once ready.
maria: long-term followup: normalize importer to strip leading slashes on write + add a lint in preflight that tolerates both formats. filed infra ticket INFRA-1229.
raj: for this release we will pin image sha: ghcr.io/redwood/inference-api@sha256:abc123... and proceed once amanda gives go. no feature flags changed.
amanda: ok. once leo confirms dry-run and @sre-ops posts the audit entry, i'll unpause. target re-run and rollout in the 23:00 UTC window.
leo: dry-run list posted. will run actual migration at +10m after ack.
sre-ops: audit recorded: ID=AUDIT-20260321-01, monitoring hooks added to canary route.
amanda: unpausing now. `/release unpause 1754443333`
deploy-bot: release unpaused by amanda. proceeding with canary pin=sha256:abc123... Canary started.
ci-bot: canary health check passed after 3m. metrics: p50 latency +2ms, 0 errors.
sre-ops: monitoring green. proceeding to gradual rollout per policy.
leo: migration completed and old params left intact (no delete) to be cleaned up after 48h.
amanda: thanks team. followups: INFRA-1229 (normalize importer), cleanup ticket INFRA-1230 (delete legacy / keys after 48h). closing thread once prod stable. :tada:
